players.product: BUZZ HPC GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB200 / GB300 / B200 / H200 clusters in Bell AI Fabric data centers in Canada) plus HPC colocation conversions of owned sites (Boden Sweden, Toronto gigafactory)

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's 8-K (Item 8.01 and the August 17, 2026 release) on the five-year GPU cloud services agreement with an investment-grade enterprise customer (not named): the dedicated cluster will consist of 2,016 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs in NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 rack-scale systems, interconnected with NVIDIA Quantum-X800 InfiniBand networking and supported by VAST Data's high-performance storage platform, deployed at the Bell AI Fabric facility in Merritt, British Columbia during the fourth quarter of the 2026 calendar year; estimated total contract value is approximately $350 million over the five-year term. BUZZ HPC's total annualized revenue of approximately $180 million comprises approximately $35 million of active, realized ARR and approximately $145 million of contracted ARR expected to come online through Q4 2026; once the NVIDIA infrastructure is deployed in calendar Q4, HIVE's HPC/AI daily revenue will be approximately $500,000.
quarterly_data.figure: 2,016 GB300 GPUs; ~$350 million TCV over five years; ~$35 million active + ~$145 million contracted ARR; HPC/AI daily revenue ~$500,000 after Q4 deployment

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE Executive Chairman Frank Holmes (8-K exhibit): with approximately 400 MW of capacity in Canada for Tier III data center development, HIVE has the potential to bring over 120,000 GPUs online over the next 2 years.
quarterly_data.figure: ~400 MW Canadian Tier III capacity; potential >120,000 GPUs over 2 years
